title: Poly-OPD: Heterogeneous Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Capability-Selectable Flow Models
abstract: Leading open text-to-image models often carry complementary strengths: one may lead on preference-aligned aesthetics while another follows compositional instructions more faithfully. However, differences in their autoencoders and noise schedules make it difficult to transfer these strengths across models. In this paper, we present Poly-OPD, a framework that can consolidate complementary strengths of heterogeneous teachers into a single compact flow-matching student. To bridge the incompatible latent spaces of different teachers, Poly-OPD performs on-policy distillation through a pixel bridge. Each student-generated image is re-encoded by a selected teacher's encoder and refined from a noise level matched by magnitude under the teacher's noise schedule. The resulting target is further matched to the student in frozen DINOv2 space, enabling supervision across incompatible latent spaces. To retain complementary capabilities without cross-teacher interference, Poly-OPD uses a gradient compatibility diagnostic to organize its adapters: attention LoRA modules are shared across teachers, whereas feed-forward adapters remain teacher-specific. During distillation, a gap-aware curriculum devotes more training to compositional categories where the student still falls short of the teacher. As each gap narrows, training shifts toward categories with larger remaining gaps. By distilling FLUX.1-dev and Z-Image into a 2.5B SD3.5-Medium student, Poly-OPD improves GenEval from 67.3 to 73.3, surpassing both larger teachers, and raises DrawBench HPSv3 from 9.34 to 11.35, consolidating both strengths within a switchable model.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 2608.04349v1 全文整理；Paper URL 精确指向本次审阅版本；PDF 未打印可核验的 code repository，故不添加 Code 链接。
analysis.ideaZh: 通过 pixel bridge 和 frozen DINOv2 feature target，在学生自己的 rollout states 上整合 latent space/noise schedule 不兼容的 image-generation teachers，再以 shared attention LoRA 与 capability-specific FFN adapters 隔离冲突。
methodFlow: 以 teacher-generated images 对学生执行 500-step warm start
从学生自身 rollout 解码图像，经 pixel bridge 重编码到所选 teacher latent
按 noise magnitude 对齐 schedule，由 teacher refinement 产生 on-policy target
在 frozen DINOv2 CLS space 匹配 student reroll 与 teacher target
共享 attention LoRA、切换 capability-specific FFN adapter，并按 residual gap 分配 composition prompts
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 它属于主流 Image Generation 的能力蒸馏与模型整合；pixel-space on-policy bridge 对未来把不同 2D design/generation specialists 合并到一个基础模型也有直接启发。
analysis.evidenceZh: 作者报告 Poly-OPD composition mode 的 GenEval 为 73.30，高于 base student 67.30、FLUX 65.20 与 Z-Image 69.40（Table 2, p. 5）；作者报告 preference mode 的 ImageReward/HPSv3 为 1.168/11.354，相比 base student 的 0.922/9.341 均提高（Table 1, p. 5）；作者报告移除 capability-selectable adapter 后 GenEval/HPSv3 为 62.3/10.117，完整模型为 73.3/11.354（Tables 3-4, p. 6）。
analysis.caveatZh: 作者限制：论文没有单独的 limitations section；结论仅说明当前展示的是 heterogeneous teacher consolidation 与 selectable adapter setting；主实验只蒸馏 FLUX.1-dev 与 Z-Image 两个 teachers，并只形成 preference/composition 两种 capability modes。审阅风险：所谓单模型能力合并仍依赖 inference-time adapter swap，用户必须预先知道该选择 aesthetics 还是 composition；论文未评估自动 routing 或两种诉求同时出现的 prompt；结论主要来自 automated reward models 与 object-composition detectors，且多个 reward metric 变化不一致；没有 human preference study 验证视觉质量提升；训练需无梯度 student rollout、teacher re-encoding/refinement、student tail reroll 与 DINOv2 feature pass，论文未给 wall-clock、显存或相对普通离线蒸馏的成本。
analysis.motivationZh: 不同 open text-to-image models 往往分别擅长 aesthetics 或 composition，但不兼容的 autoencoders、noise schedules 和 gradient directions 让这些能力难以直接蒸馏到一个 compact student。
analysis.methodZh: 学生先从自身 trajectory 生成图像，再经 pixel space 进入当前 teacher 的 VAE latent；依据 noise magnitude 对齐 schedule 后，由 teacher refinement 产生 target，最后在 frozen DINOv2 feature space 监督学生的重跑轨迹。作者用 1,000 个 paired samples 的 gradient cosine 发现 attention updates 较兼容、FFN updates 会冲突，因此共享 attention LoRA、隔离每种能力的 FFN adapter；composition prompt 再按剩余 teacher–student gap 动态采样。系统在 DrawBench、GenEval 和 DPG-Bench 上展示 aesthetic 与 composition 的联合提升，但推理时仍需明确选择 adapter mode。
analysis.experimentsZh: 2.5B SD3.5-Medium student 分别从 12B FLUX.1-dev 学 preference、从 6B Z-Image 学 composition；先 warm start 500 steps，再用 20-step Euler sampler 做 800 OPD steps。DrawBench 测 automated preference，GenEval 与 DPG-Bench 使用 composition adapter。关键结果：composition mode 的 GenEval 为 73.30，base student/FLUX/Z-Image 分别为 67.30/65.20/69.40；preference mode 的 ImageReward/HPSv3 为 1.168/11.354。移除 capability-selectable adapter 后，GenEval/HPSv3 降到 62.3/10.117。基线覆盖：直接比较 student initialization 与两个 teachers，但没有和其他 multi-teacher amalgamation、multi-LoRA routing 或 compute-matched distillation 做端到端比较；评价也主要依赖 automatic metrics。消融：覆盖 adapter sharing、gap-aware sampling、warm start、teacher refinement noise 与 perceptual feature space；结果支持设计选择，但没有 gradient-diagnostic seeds、人类偏好或更多 teacher/capability 扩展。
analysis.insightZh: 最有价值的点是让 heterogeneous diffusion/flow teachers 不需要共享 VAE 或 noise schedule：pixel bridge 与 semantic feature loss 把 teacher correction 变成学生访问状态上的 on-policy supervision。用实测 gradient compatibility 决定 adapter sharing boundary、再用 residual gap 调度子技能也较完整；不过 capability-selectable 最终仍是 adapter routing，不是单一参数状态同时输出全部能力。heterogeneous on-policy bridge、实测 sharing boundary 与 residual-gap curriculum 都有明确方法和消融证据，值得收录；但目前只是两个 teacher/two-mode proof of concept，缺少人评、成本与自动 routing，所以 accept-skim。
